submitted.rationale: Illumination is 2.1 eV, so the film must absorb below the pyrochlore Pb2Sb2O7 gap (~2.5 eV) and far below PbSb2O6 (wide gap). Pb-rich films that contain PbO/Pb3O4 absorb near 2.1 eV. Measured EQE: idx0 (Pb 0.83) 0.0081%, idx3 (Pb 0.74) 0.0090%, idx13 (Pb 0.52, pyrochlore) 0.0009%. Index 3 had the highest measured merit.

rejected.reason: Measured 0.00092%. The Pb2Sb2O7 pyrochlore region is too wide-gap for 2.1 eV light.
Wide-gap phase that barely absorbs 2.1 eV photons; the GP predicted near-zero mean.
